text:
samantha.j: Quick heads-up — onboarding hiccup for new IC. Priya (ist timezone) asked for a condensed, async-heavy onboarding because of chronic migraines and limited daytime overlap. Manager (kevin.m) says mentor time is critical and performance flags are starting. @anita.hr can you advise on formal steps?

anita.hr: Thanks for flagging. We should treat this as an accommodation request. Ask Priya to submit the ADA intake (simple form) and docs if she's comfortable. We can implement temporary adjustments while docs are pending.

kevin.m: Appreciate that. My worry is ramping: shadowing, real-time troubleshooting, and code reviews need live pairing. I don't want Priya to fall behind. Any suggestions for keeping ramp quality without daily overlap?

leo.eng: We did something similar for a contractor last year. Mix of recorded walkthroughs + scheduled 30-min overlap windows worked. Also rotate buddy reviewers so not always the same timezone.

priya.k: Thanks all. I filed the intake this morning (had to step out during the first call bc of a migraine). I can share a brief note from my doc but need a little time to get the full paperwork. Would a 2x/week 30-min overlap + async task list be acceptable? Happy to do recorded walkthroughs.

anita.hr: That sounds reasonable as an interim plan. Template we use: 1) document accommodations, 2) define metrics for success (ramp milestones), 3) set a 30-day check-in. I'll draft a temporary accommodation plan and loop in Kevin & Priya for sign-off.

kevin.m: OK. For the overlap windows, can we try `09:30-10:00 PST` / `22:00-22:30 IST` twice a week? We can use those for pairing and live Q&A only. Rest can be async (written tasks, Loom vids).

priya.k: `09:30-10:00 PST` works a lot better than daily daytime overlap — I can plan meds around it. Appreciate the flexibility.

hr-bot: Case created: HR-7682 — "onboarding accommodation: Priya K". Intake received 1767807850. Assigned: anita.hr.

anita.hr: I'll create a short written plan and send it as a thread doc for signatures. We'll include: overlap cadence, documentation timeline, defined ramp checkpoints (first PR review, independent debug of small bug, feature touchpoint). If anything changes medically, Priya, DM me and we can adjust.

leo.eng: Also recommend recorded pair sessions (Loom) and a lightweight onboarding checklist in the repo so reviewers can follow context async. I'm copying our onboarding checklist template and will add reviewers for the first month.

kevin.m: Thanks. I'll scope Priya's first sprint to async-friendly tasks + one small live debugging session. If we hit blockers, we'll escalate to Anita.

priya.k: Appreciate everyone. I'll upload the doc note when I have it and sign the interim plan.

anita.hr: Great — next step: I'll post the draft plan here by EOD tomorrow and schedule the 30-day check-in. :white_check_mark:
